name: getTrainingForNeed
description: Finds training needs matching a user-described requirement (e.g. 'MS Excel', 'DevOps'), grouped by the merged need category an Admin gives them (e.g. 'MS Office'). If any raw request under that category has already had a course created from it, recommends that course by name; otherwise reports the category's conversion status (Convertible/NotConvertible) so the user knows no course exists yet. Falls back to a name-based match against the course catalog when no official course link is recorded.\n
taskName: Finding Training Related to a Described Need
